title: An Open Study for Steroid Resistant, Non-Thymectomized MG Patients
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to investigate the efficacy and safety for steroid resistant, non-thymectomized MG patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinically diagnosed as myasthenia gravis
* Those whose MG symptoms are not controlled by the treatment with prednisone

Exclusion Criteria:

* Those who had undergone thymectomy
